tests.surface: Customer API key/JWT at edge and regional load balancer
tests.threat: A credential for organization A is replayed with paths, headers, or payloads naming organization B, another project/environment, or a forbidden scope.
tests.test: Create two organizations with disjoint keys and resources; attempt every included read/write/watch/renew/release operation across org, project, environment, and scope boundaries. Assert fail-closed status and no state/audit leakage.
tests.evidence_required: CI report plus exact-candidate live run with tenant-safe request IDs

tests.surface: Direct node client API and LB-injected identity headers
tests.threat: An internet or in-cluster caller bypasses the LB or forges x-fiducia-* identity/trust headers.
tests.test: Reach node routes directly with no internal secret, wrong secret, duplicated trust headers, mixed casing, comma-joined values, and client-supplied org/scope/key headers. Assert denial and verify the LB strips then injects one canonical identity.
tests.evidence_required: Packet/request transcript with secrets redacted and rendered network-policy proof

tests.surface: Customer dashboard Supabase session verification
tests.threat: A valid token from the wrong Supabase project, issuer, audience, or user-controlled metadata grants membership or role authority.
tests.test: Exercise wrong project/issuer/audience, unsigned/expired token, unknown kid, remote-userinfo production flag, user_metadata-only org, stale membership, and duplicated cookie/header cases. Assert offline verification and app_metadata-only authority.
tests.evidence_required: Auth CI matrix and clean-browser negative run

tests.surface: Administrator dashboard and operator registry
tests.threat: A customer session, customer key scope, email allowlist, or user-editable role reaches operator-only functions.
tests.test: Attempt admin routes with customer JWTs/keys, top-level role only, user_metadata role, wrong admin Supabase project, removed operator-registry entry, and stale session. Assert two independent trusted checks and audited denial.
tests.evidence_required: Browser-driver report across Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium

tests.surface: API-key introspection, rotation, revocation, and caches
tests.threat: A revoked or rotated key remains accepted beyond the declared positive-cache overlap, or a stale cache outlives authoritative version changes.
tests.test: Prime every edge/LB cache, rotate and revoke the key, fail one auth replica/site, advance/restart caches, and probe all ingress paths until rejection. Verify p99 <= 60 seconds and no stale key is reintroduced after recovery/restore.
tests.evidence_required: Timestamped propagation histogram tied to release digest

tests.surface: Internal /v1/introspect versus public /v1/token
tests.threat: The introspection oracle is exposed without server authentication, or the public token exchange can mint wider org/scopes than the presented key.
tests.test: Call introspect without/wrong/duplicated x-server-auth and call token with invalid, revoked, cross-org, and legacy over-scoped keys. Assert introspect denial and token claims restricted to the authoritative presented key.
tests.automation_target: fiducia-auth.rs integration tests plus external ingress scan
tests.evidence_required: CI test plus network reachability report

tests.surface: Trusted edge identity forwarding
tests.threat: Client-controlled trust headers, redirect targets, or leader hints cause credential forwarding to an untrusted host.
tests.test: Inject x-fiducia-* and edge-auth headers, malicious Host, userinfo/query/fragment URLs, 3xx and NotLeader hints to unregistered hosts, and DNS/path encoding variants. Assert stripping, membership-bound retry targets, and no secret forwarding.
tests.evidence_required: CI transcript and egress capture proving no trusted secret left approved members

tests.surface: Customer browser, cookies, CORS, CSP, and sensitive responses
tests.threat: Cross-origin requests, weak cookie policy, caching, browser storage, or frontend logging exposes sessions or one-time API-key plaintext.
tests.test: Exercise evil origin/null origin, CSRF-like form requests, wildcard/preflight cases, duplicate cookies, browser back/refresh, service worker/cache, local/session storage, console/network logging, and screenshot artifact collection after key create/rotate.
tests.evidence_required: Three-browser-engine artifact set with automated storage/log redaction assertions

tests.surface: Encrypted KV writes
tests.threat: A production caller writes plaintext or bypasses encryption through content type, alternate route, batch shape, replay, or configuration drift.
tests.test: Attempt plaintext:true and equivalent bypasses across all KV write/update/batch/idempotent paths and rendered production configuration. Assert denial before commit and no plaintext in Raft/PVC/snapshot/log evidence.
tests.evidence_required: CI negative tests, rendered policy check, and encrypted-at-rest inspection

tests.surface: KV prefix/path ACL and ESO guarded path
tests.threat: Path traversal, percent/double encoding, Unicode normalization, prefix confusion, watch/list expansion, or ESO namespace/service-account reuse crosses a secret boundary.
tests.test: Generate adversarial path corpus across read/write/delete/list/watch and ESO reconciliation; include encoded slash/dot, duplicate separators, Unicode confusables, shared prefixes, empty/root paths, and wrong namespace/service account.
tests.evidence_required: Property/corpus test report plus live namespace isolation run

tests.surface: ESO/client to LB/node TLS and CA trust
tests.threat: A wrong, expired, revoked, self-signed, hostname-mismatched, or attacker-controlled certificate is accepted, or production silently falls back to cleartext.
tests.test: Exercise valid/invalid CA chains, rotation overlap, expired/not-yet-valid certs, hostname mismatch, cleartext endpoint, missing trust bundle, and one-site certificate rotation. Assert fail-closed readiness and recovery without broad insecure skip flags.
tests.evidence_required: CI TLS matrix and live CA rotation report

tests.surface: Logs, metrics, traces, audits, CI, browser, and support artifacts
tests.threat: Secret values, raw API keys/JWTs/cookies, private key material, customer paths, or unbounded customer text leaks into evidence or high-cardinality telemetry.
tests.test: Seed unique canary secrets/tokens and exercise success/error/timeout/retry paths; scan all telemetry stores, CI artifacts, browser output, support bundles, screenshots, and exported audits for exact/encoded/partial forms and forbidden labels.
tests.evidence_required: Signed scan summary with storage locations and retention window

tests.surface: Encryption keyring, SOPS/secret-store bootstrap, and auth roots
tests.threat: Fiducia cannot start or decrypt backups because its only bootstrap/decryption credential is stored solely inside Fiducia or on a lost device.
tests.test: Start from clean hardware/account context with the live cluster unavailable; recover required keys from independently controlled custody, verify authorization/audit, restore representative ciphertext, and revoke the simulated lost device.
tests.automation_target: operator runbook plus clean-room recovery harness
tests.evidence_required: Redacted custody and restore report with no key material

tests.surface: Raft log/snapshot on persistent volumes
tests.threat: Process, pod, node, disk mount, or one-site loss discards acknowledged state or starts from empty/older state.
tests.test: Commit representative locks, leases, KV revisions, idempotency, and credential records; kill process/pod/member/site in separate cases; replace one member; assert quorum service and monotonic state after restart/catch-up.
tests.evidence_required: Fault timeline, state digest, term/index, revision/token comparison, and release digest

tests.surface: Node and brain append/vote/snapshot/membership traffic
tests.threat: An unauthenticated or wrong-cluster peer sends votes, logs, snapshots, or membership changes; replay or certificate drift creates split authority.
tests.test: Attempt peer RPCs with no/wrong/old credentials and from nonmembers; exercise credential/certificate rotation during healthy quorum; assert rejected RPCs cannot alter term/log/membership and readiness exposes degraded trust safely.
tests.evidence_required: CI protocol matrix and live rotation/partition report

tests.surface: Locks, leases, elections, tasks, and downstream reference system
tests.threat: A paused/partitioned former holder continues external mutation after a newer grant or leader exists.
tests.test: Grant token N, pause/partition holder, expire/transfer and grant N+1, allow N+1 mutation, resume old holder, and assert the downstream reference table/middleware rejects token N across process/site failure and restore.
tests.evidence_required: Database transaction log showing accepted N+1 and rejected N tied to fault timeline

tests.surface: Cross-site Raft and client routing under asymmetric network failure
tests.threat: Asymmetric partition, high latency, clock drift, or stale routing produces dual leaders, minority writes, or unsafe retries.
tests.test: Inject bidirectional and one-way partitions, WAN delay/loss, bounded clock drift, leader isolation, and stale LB hints. Assert one quorum commits, minority fails closed, mutations with ambiguous transport are not replayed, and healing preserves one monotonic log.
tests.automation_target: fiducia-infra/kind/multicluster chaos suite plus live drill
tests.evidence_required: Network fault config, term/commit traces, client result classification, and healed state digest

tests.surface: healthz/readyz/status, actor queues, storage, placement, and routing
tests.threat: A half-initialized or wedged component reports ready and serves ambiguous or unscoped success.
tests.test: Remove required secret/storage/CA, wedge actor inbox, deny placement refresh, corrupt/partial routing table, lose quorum, and fail sidecar/brain independently. Assert readiness 503 or scoped denial while liveness remains semantically correct.
tests.evidence_required: Probe timeline and routing exclusion proof

tests.surface: Encrypted Raft snapshots/WAL and required control-plane stores
tests.threat: A backup exists but cannot restore, omits required key versions/indexes, crosses tenants, or rewinds revisions/fencing/revocations.
tests.test: Restore into a clean cluster using external backup and independent key custody; compare tenant-safe state digest, revisions/CAS, locks/leases, fencing tokens, credential versions/revocations, indexes, and audit continuity; then serve synthetic traffic.
tests.evidence_required: Backup object/version, restore timestamps, digest comparison, RPO/RTO, and reviewer sign-off

tests.surface: Application rollback, schema migration abort, and stateful member replacement
tests.threat: Rollback or migration abort rewinds authority, replaces multiple voters, revives revoked credentials, or loads incompatible state.
tests.test: Deploy a forward-compatible candidate, execute follower-first change, interrupt at each checkpoint, roll back stateless components, abort/migrate state safely, and assert no revision/token/credential/audit regression or second-voter replacement.
tests.evidence_required: Checkpoint-by-checkpoint runbook output and state comparison

tests.surface: OTel agents/gateway, metrics, logs, traces, audit projections
tests.threat: A sink outage blocks coordination indefinitely, drops critical evidence silently, leaks secrets through retry buffers, or creates unbounded memory/disk/cardinality growth.
tests.test: Stop each telemetry sink/gateway, fill bounded queues, inject high-cardinality customer input, restart collectors, and verify coordination remains within policy, drops/backpressure are alerted, disk/memory stay bounded, and canary secrets remain absent.
tests.evidence_required: Resource graphs, drop/backpressure alerts, and redaction scan

tests.surface: Rust/JS dependencies, generated interfaces, Nix and container inputs
tests.threat: A mutable sibling branch/tag, unlocked dependency, generated-contract drift, or divergent local/container build changes runtime semantics.
tests.test: Fail CI on mutable/abbreviated sibling refs, stale generated contracts, unlocked package resolution, Rust/toolchain drift, and Docker/Nix output mismatch. Build twice from a clean checkout and compare declared artifact identity.
tests.evidence_required: CI run across pinned submodule revisions and parity report

tests.surface: OCI image, registry, SBOM, provenance, signature, and runtime digest
tests.threat: Production runs an image different from the reviewed source/config, follows a mutable tag, builds source inside the pod, or ignores a critical vulnerability/policy failure.
tests.test: Produce SBOM/provenance/signature, reject unsigned or wrong-subject images, mutate a tag after approval, attempt source build in pod, introduce policy test vulnerability, and verify rendered GitOps/runtime use the approved digest only.
tests.automation_target: fiducia-infra policy CI plus registry/runtime admission verification
tests.evidence_required: Attestation URLs, policy results, rendered digest, and running pod imageID

tests.surface: Topology, Kustomize overlays, GitOps promotion, and emergency changes
tests.threat: Rendered topology is stale/partial, failure-domain labels overclaim real providers, production drifts from Git, or simultaneous voter changes lose quorum.
tests.test: Run topology render --check, policy-check every overlay, verify synthetic provider disclosure, compare live objects to Git, attempt unsafe two-voter rollout, and exercise logged emergency containment followed by reconciliation.
tests.automation_target: fiducia-infra renderer/policy tests and GitOps drift detector
tests.evidence_required: Rendered diff, policy report, live drift report, and safe rollout transcript

tests.surface: Laptop/site identity, SSH, mesh VPN, registry/Git, TLS, SOPS, and runtime secret access
tests.threat: A lost or stolen site device retains management, deployment, peer, backup, or secret authority after revocation.
tests.test: Revoke a simulated lost laptop across mesh, SSH, Git/registry, TLS, SOPS recipients, Kubernetes credentials, backup access, and runtime secrets; then attempt every old identity while a clean replacement joins and catches up.
tests.automation_target: DEN-946 lost-device runbook with verification script
tests.evidence_required: Redacted revocation checklist, denied-access probes, replacement identity/catch-up report

tests.surface: Operator support, break-glass, tenant disable, status communication, and evidence handling
tests.threat: No accountable operator can contain an incident, or support/break-glass access is unaudited, over-broad, or leaks customer secrets.
tests.test: Run a tabletop and live bounded drill: page the roster, declare severity, disable one tenant/credential/capability, communicate through status process, preserve redacted evidence, restore service, revoke break-glass, and complete review.
tests.automation_target: DEN-1390 incident drill and operator runbook
tests.evidence_required: Timestamped drill record, notification evidence, audit entries, and independent reviewer
